plugins.locationWhenInUsePermission: RoughRoute uses your location for navigation and to record GPS speed alongside road motion.

plugins.motionPermission: RoughRoute records accelerometer and gyroscope data to measure road motion.

plugins.cameraPermission: RoughRoute uses the camera to film a demonstration video alongside its motion recordings.
plugins.microphonePermission: RoughRoute uses the microphone to add audio to the demonstration video.
